StancePayload.description: SUPPORT or CONTRADICT: one agent's evidence bearing on another agent's post.

clue_ids.description: CLUEs that justify the stance (the sender's own, or cited symptoms).
clue_ids.title: Clue Ids

strength.description: How strongly the evidence bears on the target.
strength.title: Strength

target_msg_id.description: msg_id of the CLUE or HYPOTHESIS being supported/contradicted.
target_msg_id.title: Target Msg Id

StancePayload.title: StancePayload

adaptations.description: Version conversions applied, e.g. '1.0->2.0', and any lossy fields.
adaptations.title: Adaptations

causation_id.description: msg_id of the message that caused this one (null = root).
causation_id.title: Causation Id

correlation_id.description: Incident id shared by every message of one diagnosis run.
correlation_id.title: Correlation Id

depth.description: Causation depth: 0 for roots, parent depth + 1 otherwise.
depth.title: Depth

msg_id.description: Unique message id; content hash when built by make_message.
msg_id.title: Msg Id

recipient.description: agent_id of the recipient, or 'board' for a shared post.
recipient.title: Recipient

schema_version.description: Controlled-vocabulary version the payload's terms refer to.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

timestamp.description: Creation time, ISO-8601 UTC (excluded from msg_id).
timestamp.title: Timestamp
